member_axis: B: same present observation, different replayed history
controller_axis: config.json controllers_test order; last three held out

arrays.force_mse: [history pair, member, controller, wait, action], mean squared error across all 500 future force samples; N squared
arrays.contrast_mse: [history pair, controller, wait, action], mean squared error of predicted B-minus-A force response; N squared
arrays.contrast_signal: same axes; mean squared true B-minus-A response; denominator for effect NRMSE
arrays.time: [history pair, member, controller, wait, action], predicted first sustained goal time; infinity if no completion
arrays.peak: same axes, predicted maximum force over the complete 5s forecast
arrays.decision_choice: [history pair, member, controller, wait, cap], action index, -1 reject
arrays.decision_success: same axes, actual sustained goal within horizon AND actual whole-horizon peak <= cap
arrays.decision_unsafe: same axes, actual peak > cap after execution; rejection is false
arrays.decision_reject: same axes, no predicted feasible action
arrays.decision_cost: same axes, actual first goal time if safely successful; 6 seconds otherwise
arrays.decision_time: same axes, actual first goal time, infinity if executed but incomplete; NaN for rejection
arrays.decision_peak: same axes, actual whole-horizon peak; NaN for rejection

reactive: No predicted arrays or action index; feedback policy evaluated separately. Same decision axis and actual outcome definitions.
statistical_unit: whole pair. Never treat controller, wait, candidate action, or force-cap branches of the same history as independent replicates.
provenance: Synthetic simulation only. Future measured trajectories are labels/evaluation, never model inputs. No real material or robot data.
